matchmaking_summary: The candidate has a broad and deep background in information technology with significant experience in curriculum design, computer-based training development, and customer service. With over seventeen years of professional experience in the field, they have demonstrated expertise in advanced problem solving skills and project management across multiple roles within the sector. Their technical skill set is particularly notable for its depth and breadth, covering software like Photoshop, Premier, Illustrator, Dreamweaver, Fireworks, Powerpoint, Word, Outlook, and various others, as well as hardware including Mac OS and Windows OS. This combination of theoretical knowledge and practical experience positions them strongly in leadership roles across IT departments.
